XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: When the engine is hot, lack of throttle response and engine fault warning light comes on.

XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Injection

  • Device: Canister solenoid valve

  • Fault: When the engine is warm, the vehicle exhibits a malfunction with the accelerator pedal, which fails to respond when pressed. The engine remains at idle speed even when the pedal is pressed, whilst the engine fault warning light on the instrument panel illuminates.

  • Fault codes detected by the self-diagnostic system:
    • P0101 (Mass Air Flow Sensor – Incorrect setpoint)
    • C1221 (Accelerator pedal sensor, NCM control – Invalid signal)
  • Cause: Faulty canister solenoid valve

• Action: Check that the canister solenoid valve is working properly; replace it if necessary.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The solenoid valve is connected to the intake manifold, on the driver's side between the engine and the wheel. In this case, the manifold pressure sensor was initially replaced, the throttle body was cleaned and the auto-adaptive parameters were reset, without resolving the fault. The definitive solution came with the replacement of the canister solenoid valve alone. The defective component did not show any visual faults.
